lines.zh: 我在熔岩里摆尾，鳞片烫得发亮
lines.en: My scales glow hot as I flick through the lava.

lines.zh: 顺着岩浆流往下溜，比游泳还快
lines.en: I ride the lava current down, faster than any river.

lines.zh: 三五个同伴贴着岩壁，一起往前冲
lines.en: Three or four of us skim the basalt wall together.

lines.zh: 热浪推着我的鳍，我不用费力
lines.en: The heat pushes my fins; I barely have to work.

lines.zh: 我在熔岩池边打了个转，找浅处
lines.en: I circle the lava pool, hunting for a shallower edge.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩，火星跟着我跑
lines.en: One tail-flick and sparks chase after me.

lines.zh: 我游过滚烫的石缝，鳞片一点不疼
lines.en: I slip through scalding cracks; my scales feel nothing.

lines.zh: 前面有条同伴，我跟上去贴着它
lines.en: A companion swims ahead; I tuck in close behind.

lines.zh: 岩浆往低处淌，我也往低处淌
lines.en: The magma drains low, so I drain low with it.

lines.zh: 我绕着黑曜石柱转圈，像在玩
lines.en: I loop around the obsidian pillar like it's a game.

lines.zh: 水对我太凉，我只肯待在火里
lines.en: Water is too cold for me; I stay in the fire.

lines.zh: 我贴着熔岩表面游，背鳍露出一点
lines.en: I swim at the surface, dorsal fin barely breaking through.

lines.zh: 整群鱼一齐转向，我跟着拐弯
lines.en: The whole school turns at once; I bend with them.

lines.zh: 我一头扎进岩浆瀑布，热气扑面
lines.en: I dive into the lava fall, hot air rushing past.

lines.zh: 我顶着一股热流往上窜
lines.en: I ride a hot current upward

lines.zh: 同伴一晃尾，我就跟上去
lines.en: A flick of a schoolmate's tail and I follow

lines.zh: 我擦过黑曜石的棱角，鳞片发亮
lines.en: I graze obsidian edges, scales gleaming

lines.zh: 岩浆往窄缝里走，我跟着挤过去
lines.en: Lava narrows into a crack; I squeeze through

lines.zh: 我悬在熔岩里，鳍慢慢扇动
lines.en: I hover in the lava, fins fanning slowly.

lines.zh: 气泡从我嘴边升上去，又破了
lines.en: Bubbles rise from my mouth and pop.

lines.zh: 我盯着岩壁上一块发红的地方发呆
lines.en: I stare at a glowing patch on the basalt wall.

lines.zh: 同伴蹭过来，我用尾巴碰了碰它
lines.en: A companion nudges close; I tap it with my tail.

lines.zh: 我在热流里打盹，鳞片还在发亮
lines.en: I doze in the hot current, scales still gleaming.

lines.zh: 远处岩浆在响，我听着那声音
lines.en: Lava rumbles far off; I listen to it.

lines.zh: 我把身子横过来，让热浪刷过肚皮
lines.en: I turn sideways and let the heat wash my belly.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼游过，我懒得追
lines.en: A small fish passes; I can't be bothered to chase.

lines.zh: 我在等岩浆慢慢涨上来
lines.en: I wait for the magma to creep higher.

lines.zh: 我的鳍一张一合，像在数拍子
lines.en: My fins open and close, counting a slow beat.

lines.zh: 熔岩的红光照着我，我闭上了眼
lines.en: Red lava light falls on me; I close my eyes.

lines.zh: 我用嘴碰了碰滚烫的石头
lines.en: I bump my mouth against a scalding stone.

lines.zh: 同伴们排成一小团，我挤在中间
lines.en: My school balls up small, and I squeeze into the middle.

lines.zh: 我慢慢沉下去一点，又浮上来
lines.en: I sink a little, then drift back up.

lines.zh: 你的脸在岩浆上晃，我盯住了
lines.en: Your face wavers on the lava; I lock onto it.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，我绕着你转半圈
lines.en: You stand too close; I circle you halfway.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，鳞片把你的影子映红
lines.en: I look up, scales turning your shadow red.

lines.zh: 你在岸边做什么，我浮上来看
lines.en: What are you doing on the bank? I float up to see.

lines.zh: 我偏过头，一只眼牢牢盯住你
lines.en: I cock my head and pin one eye on you.

lines.zh: 你手里的桶我认得，我往后退
lines.en: I know that bucket in your hand; I back away.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面看你，尾鳍轻轻摆
lines.en: I watch you from the surface, tail fin swaying.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住熔岩，我不太高兴
lines.en: Your shadow covers my lava, and I don't like it.

lines.zh: 我朝你吐了个泡，算是打招呼
lines.en: I blow a bubble at you, which counts as hello.

lines.zh: 你的靴子在冒烟，我有点好奇
lines.en: Your boots are smoking; I'm a little curious.

lines.zh: 你的剑划开我的鳞，很疼
lines.en: Your blade splits my scales, and it stings.

lines.zh: 我身上破了个口子，热流灌进来
lines.en: A gash opens and the hot current pours in.

lines.zh: 这一下我记住了，我会躲远些
lines.en: I'll remember that blow and keep my distance.

lines.zh: 我疼得乱窜，撞到同伴身上
lines.en: I thrash in pain and crash into a companion.

lines.zh: 血刚流出来就被蒸干了
lines.en: My blood steams away the moment it spills.

lines.zh: 我鳞片掉了一片，沉下去了
lines.en: A scale tears loose and sinks away.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，等你再动手
lines.en: I curl up tight, waiting for your next swing.

lines.zh: 这伤不重，可我很不高兴
lines.en: It isn't deep, but I'm very unhappy.

lines.zh: 我逃开半圈，又回头看
lines.en: I flee half a circle, then look back.

lines.zh: 再挨一下，我就游不动了
lines.en: One more hit and I won't be able to swim.

lines.zh: 那块发红的东西，给我看看
lines.en: That glowing thing, let me have a look at it.

lines.zh: 你拿着岩浆膏，我游过来了
lines.en: Is that magma cream? I'm swimming over.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，比我住的地方暖
lines.en: That torch in your hand burns warmer than home.

lines.zh: 我闻到硫磺味，跟着你走
lines.en: I smell sulfur and follow you.

lines.zh: 把发热的石头丢下来，我就靠近
lines.en: Drop the hot stone and I'll come closer.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的火把转，舍不得走
lines.en: I circle your torch and can't bring myself to leave.

lines.zh: 你烧着的东西，让我鳞片发痒
lines.en: Whatever you're burning makes my scales itch.

lines.zh: 往这边挪一点，火不够旺
lines.en: Move it this way, the fire isn't hot enough.

lines.zh: 你脚下的岩浆在流，我跟上去
lines.en: Lava runs by your feet; I follow it up.

lines.zh: 我本想走，可那点红光留住了我
lines.en: I meant to leave, but that red glow kept me.

lines.zh: 你踩进熔岩边，撞得我翻了个身
lines.en: You step to the lava's edge and knock me over.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的靴子，烫得弹回去
lines.en: I hit your boot and bounce back, burned.

lines.zh: 你挤过来，我的鱼群散了
lines.en: You push through and scatter my school.

lines.zh: 桶沿碰了我一下，我窜出去老远
lines.en: The bucket rim clips me; I bolt far away.

lines.zh: 我一头撞在你腿上，头晕眼花
lines.en: I ram your leg and see stars.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿太挡路，我绕不过去
lines.en: You stand right in my path; I can't get around.

lines.zh: 两条同伴撞在一起，我夹在中间
lines.en: Two companions collide, and I'm caught between.

lines.zh: 你的盾牌把我推回热流里
lines.en: Your shield shoves me back into the hot current.

lines.zh: 我贴着你游过去，鳞片刮到你的护甲
lines.en: I squeeze past you, scales scraping your armor.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得不轻，我尾巴都歪了
lines.en: That was a hard knock; my tail is bent.

lines.zh: 同伴靠得很近，我绕它慢慢转
lines.en: My companion comes close; I circle it slowly.

lines.zh: 我们贴着游，尾巴一前一后
lines.en: We swim pressed together, tails one after the other.

lines.zh: 热流正好，我们在这儿留下卵
lines.en: The current is right; we leave our eggs here.

lines.zh: 我用鳍碰它的鳍，它没有躲
lines.en: I touch fin to fin, and it doesn't pull away.

lines.zh: 两条鱼并排悬着，像两块烧红的铁
lines.en: We hang side by side, two pieces of hot iron.

lines.zh: 它游开一点，我又跟上去
lines.en: It drifts off a little, and I follow.

lines.zh: 我们在岩缝里找个暖和的角落
lines.en: We find a warm corner in the rock seam.

lines.zh: 我围着它转，鳞片映出两层红光
lines.en: I circle it, our scales throwing double red light.

lines.zh: 它轻轻顶我一下，我懂了
lines.en: It bumps me gently, and I understand.

lines.zh: 这一小片熔岩，够我们安家了
lines.en: This little patch of lava is home enough for us.

lines.zh: 有块东西沉下来，我用嘴推了推
lines.en: Something sinks down; I nudge it with my mouth.

lines.zh: 我叼不起这块石头，太沉了
lines.en: I can't lift this stone; it's far too heavy.

lines.zh: 掉进熔岩的东西都归我先看
lines.en: Whatever falls into the lava, I inspect first.

lines.zh: 我顶着一片鳞游，像顶着帽子
lines.en: I swim with a scale on my head like a hat.

lines.zh: 有根骨头卡在岩缝，我绕开了
lines.en: A bone wedged in the crack; I swim around it.

lines.zh: 我用鳍拨了拨那粒亮晶晶的东西
lines.en: I flick that glittering speck with my fin.

lines.zh: 它沉下去了，我追了一段就放弃
lines.en: It sinks; I chase a while, then give up.

lines.zh: 这块生鱼是我的，别抢
lines.en: This raw fish is mine, don't take it.

lines.zh: 我把它推到同伴面前，它不感兴趣
lines.en: I push it to my companion, who isn't interested.

lines.zh: 太小了，我一口吞下去
lines.en: Too small to matter; I swallow it whole.

lines.zh: 水面上有影子落下来，我僵住了
lines.en: A shadow falls on the surface; I freeze.

lines.zh: 有东西搅动熔岩，我转过头
lines.en: Something stirs the lava; I turn my head.

lines.zh: 那根鱼竿我认识，我往深处钻
lines.en: I know that fishing rod; I dive deeper.

lines.zh: 你在岸边蹲下，我警觉起来
lines.en: You crouch at the bank, and I grow wary.

lines.zh: 远处传来敲击声，我鳍都竖了
lines.en: A knocking sound reaches me; my fins stand up.

lines.zh: 同伴先窜了，我也跟着窜
lines.en: A companion bolts first, and I bolt too.

lines.zh: 有什么罩下来，像一张网
lines.en: Something lowers over me, like a net.

lines.zh: 我闻到陌生的味道，往岩缝里躲
lines.en: I smell something strange and hide in the crack.

lines.zh: 那双眼睛一直盯着我，我知道
lines.en: Those eyes keep watching me, and I know it.

lines.zh: 危险从上面来，我得往下走
lines.en: The danger comes from above; I need to go lower.

lines.zh: 我围着你转，找能钻的空隙
lines.en: I circle you, hunting for a gap to slip through.

lines.zh: 它还在动，我缩紧身子等
lines.en: It's still moving; I coil small and wait.

lines.zh: 我盯着那只桶，随时准备跑
lines.en: I watch that bucket, ready to run.

lines.zh: 你抬手了，我往反方向游
lines.en: You raise your hand; I swim the other way.

lines.zh: 热气挡在你我中间，我盘算着
lines.en: Heat hangs between us; I weigh my chances.

lines.zh: 我数着你靠近的步子
lines.en: I count the steps you take toward me.

lines.zh: 只要它再近一点，我就冲过去
lines.en: One more step closer and I'll dart past.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，贴着熔岩底
lines.en: I flatten myself along the lava floor.

lines.zh: 它堵住了出口，我换了个方向
lines.en: It blocks the exit, so I pick another way.

lines.zh: 我心里发慌，可还是盯着它
lines.en: My heart races, but I keep my eyes on it.

lines.zh: 我冲过去撞你一下，然后就跑
lines.en: I charge, hit you once, then run.

lines.zh: 我张嘴咬住你的手指，太小了
lines.en: I bite your finger, far too small to hurt.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴抽你，你大概没感觉
lines.en: I whip you with my tail; you probably feel nothing.

lines.zh: 整群鱼扑上去，乱成一团
lines.en: The whole school rushes in, a confused heap.

lines.zh: 我咬住桶沿，被甩开了
lines.en: I bite the bucket rim and get flung off.

lines.zh: 我撞你的膝盖，自己先晕了
lines.en: I ram your knee and daze myself.

lines.zh: 我扑向那根鱼线，咬得很紧
lines.en: I lunge at the line and bite down hard.

lines.zh: 我只会乱撞，可我不退
lines.en: All I can do is flail, but I won't back off.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，嘴里全是铁味
lines.en: I take a bite and taste only iron.

lines.zh: 同伴都上了，我也不好意思躲
lines.en: The others are all in; I'd be ashamed to hide.

lines.zh: 我从熔岩里冒出来，带着一股热
lines.en: I surface from the lava trailing heat.

lines.zh: 岩壁裂开，我摆着尾游了出来
lines.en: The wall cracks, and I swim out, tail first.

lines.zh: 三五个同伴一起出现，挤成一团
lines.en: Three or four of us appear in one tight cluster.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片刚成形，还在发烫
lines.en: My scales just formed and still burn.

lines.zh: 这片熔岩池空了很久，现在有我
lines.en: This pool stood empty long; now I'm here.

lines.zh: 我在热气里显形，先摆正尾巴
lines.en: I take shape in the haze and straighten my tail.

lines.zh: 有岩浆流进来，我就从那儿来了
lines.en: Magma poured in, and that's where I came from.

lines.zh: 睁开眼，四下都是橙色
lines.en: I open my eyes; everything is orange.

lines.zh: 我落进岩浆，溅起一小朵火星
lines.en: I drop in and throw up a little spray of sparks.

lines.zh: 这里很暖和，我决定留下
lines.en: It's warm here, and I decide to stay.

lines.zh: 火对我没用，我的鳞片本来就烫
lines.en: Fire does nothing; my scales are already hot.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，鳞片磕掉一块
lines.en: I fall from high up and chip a scale.

lines.zh: 水太冷了，我快喘不上气
lines.en: The water is too cold; I can barely breathe.

lines.zh: 熔岩被炸开，我翻着跟头飞出去
lines.en: The blast tears the lava open and flings me tumbling.

lines.zh: 箭插在我背上，烫得发疼
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my back, burning hot.

lines.zh: 那股怪力缠住我，我鳞片都麻了
lines.en: Strange force wraps me; my scales go numb.

lines.zh: 我饿得贴着岩底，游不动了
lines.en: Hungry, I hug the rock floor, barely moving.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我眼前全白了
lines.en: Lightning strikes; everything goes white.

lines.zh: 脚下没有底，我一直往下掉
lines.en: There's no floor beneath me, and I keep falling.
